text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞＜Blocker＞＜Partition ([WarGreymon] & [MetalGarurumon])＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon leave the battle area, trash 1 of their Option cards in the battle area and trash their top security card.
